name: jwx-structured-jose-parse-diagnostics
instr:
jwx cannot report structured locations for malformed JWK, JWKS, JWS, JWE, JWT, or OpenID inputs. Add opt-in diagnostics for compact, JSON, and nested JOSE representations without changing parsed values, fallback behavior, or package errors.

Record issues in observation order with JSON-style paths, zero-based source offsets when available, and errors preserving standard unwrapping. Snapshots remain immutable after parsing, mutation, or reset. Separate collectors share no state, support concurrent nested parsing, and reset independently.

Cover JWK and JWKS probing, key-material, validation, and custom-field failures. Malformed key paths retain input indexes. Preserve strict, placeholder, ignored-entry, and unsupported-entry outcomes.

Distinguish envelope and component failures at exact locations in compact, flattened JSON, and general JSON JWS and JWE. Compact forms retain original offsets. Flattened JWS uses direct protected or unprotected header paths. General JWS uses stable signature indexes and their protected or unprotected header paths. JSON JWE uses direct paths for flattened forms and stable recipient indexes for general forms, distinguishing shared protected data from recipient headers and encrypted keys.

Compose JWT locations outer-to-inner while retaining lower-layer stages and causes. Locate claim decoding failures. Preserve protected-header stages and compact offsets beneath token context. Nested encrypted tokens retain recipient indexes while composing JWE an
